$note: portfolio: Nuxt/Vue + pnpm. Only tooling is Prettier (no lint, no tests; vue-tsc is not installed, so tsc --noEmit is NOT a valid typecheck here). checks.format is verify-only (--check) so it can double as the stop-gate; the global format-on-edit hook does the actual writing. build is nuxt build.
$stopCheck_note: Prettier cleanliness is the fast, deterministic gate: you cannot finish with a dirty tree while any file is unformatted. To fix, run `pnpm exec prettier --write .` (or just edit the file, the format-on-edit hook handles it). Exclusions live in .prettierignore (lockfile, build dirs, .vscode).
